findings: Non-blocking: auth env vars (ICAV2_BASE_URL, ICAV2_ACCESS_TOKEN) are written to the process-wide os.environ rather than a copied dict inside the per-tenant loop, so a tenant's token persists in-process after its iteration. Benign in the current single-shot CLI flow because every call site rewrites the token immediately before the wrapica call; would become a hazard only under concurrent/long-lived reuse.

Informational: generate_empty_bundle now forwards pipeline_release_url, and create_cwl_workflow_from_zip now sends workflow_description, to ICA where the plugin path did not expose these fields. Both are optional wrapica params; confirm ICA accepts them on create. Not runtime-verified (no live ICA call possible in this environment).
